notes.v1_07: Wagon: Remove the pebbles, the rock and the grass tufts at the bottom corners, and make the dirt road one smooth, even warm tone. Make the canvas cover a slightly whiter off-white with cool grey folds. Keep the wagon as is.
notes.v1_05: Cactus: Remove the pebbles around the base and make the sand smooth and slightly paler than the orange wall. Light from the upper left so the right arm and the right side of the trunk are slightly darker.
notes.v1_08: Windmill: Paint the wheel rim and hub a dark iron red so the wheel has strong accents, and keep the blades white. Give the stone tower a clearer, darker shadow side. Make the wheat field a smooth, slightly deeper gold with only a few blade tips.
notes.v1_01: Cowboy Hat: Light from the upper left so the right side of the crown and the right brim curl are clearly darker. Make the felt a slightly deeper, less orange brown with a deep umber shadow under the brim. Keep the background rays.
notes.v1_09: Mesa: Remove the shrubs, grass tufts and pebbles and make the sand smooth and even. Light from the left with strong sun so the right cliff faces turn deep red-brown and the top ledges catch bright light.
notes.v1_06: Horseshoe: Change the pink diamond wall to a soft sky-blue diamond pattern. Remove the pebbles and make the sand smooth. Give the horseshoe a bright silver highlight along its upper-left edge.
notes.v1_04: Cowboy Boot: Replace the dashed stitching with a few soft solid seam lines. Light the green wall evenly so its corners and the shelf edge are not darkened. Keep the boot otherwise.
